howToPlay: Use your portals to move with teammates and control the map. Deploy Walking Cane to pull enemies or Grand Piano to strike them from above, while choosing between Fake Injury for defense or New Perspective for healing.
gears: Equip Damage for increased offense at low health, Shield for extra survival, or Gadget Cooldown to use your utility items more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits tactical players who prioritize team coordination and strategic positioning.
